en.title: Splits Where the Left Sum Exceeds the Right Sum
en.description:
Split the whole array into two non-empty contiguous parts, and count the split positions where the left sum is strictly greater than the right sum.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; missing numeric ranges are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N (2..100000), and the second line contains N integers (−10000..10000).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: 10|−5,6 is valid and 10,−5|6 is not, so the answer is 1. Example 2: equality does not count, so the answer is 0. Example 3: −1>−5 and −3=−3, so only the first split is valid; the answer is 1.
hints: First compute the total, then enumerate the first N−1 split positions and compare each prefix sum with the remaining sum.
